dashboard.label: Maps+ probe - heat, feature and marker layers across refreshes (MP-03, MP-04)
dashboard.description: Probe harness, classic. H: heatA visible, heatB hidden. H2: both heat layers hidden. Same SPL and options as test/studio/probe3.json. See test/README.md.

panel.title: H - heatA (visible) and heatB (layerVisibility=false), 1 feature, 5 markers (MP-03, MP-04)

search.query: | makeresults | eval feature="34.02,-118.30;34.02,-118.20;34.08,-118.20;34.08,-118.30", featureLayer="zone", layerDescription="Zone polygon", layerVisibility="true", heatmapInclude="false" | append [| makeresults count=200 | streamstats count as n | eval latitude=34.05+(random()/2147483647-0.5)*0.1, longitude=-118.25+(random()/2147483647-0.5)*0.1, heatmapLayer=if(n<=100,"heatA","heatB"), heatmapInclude="true", layerDescription=heatmapLayer, layerVisibility=if(n<=100,"true","false"), markerVisibility="false"] | append [| makeresults count=5 | streamstats count as m | eval latitude=34.05+(m-3)*0.012, longitude=-118.25, tooltip="Marker ".m, markerType="circle", heatmapInclude="false", layerGroup="Markers", layerDescription="Markers", layerVisibility="true"] | table feature featureLayer layerDescription layerVisibility heatmapLayer heatmapInclude latitude longitude markerVisibility tooltip markerType layerGroup
